title: EV charging in Poland | VOOL
description: VOOL chargers and load management in Poland: local partners, grants and rules, and datasheets.

sections.title: EV charging for buildings in Poland, on the connection they already have
sections.lead: Chargers, load management and billing from one maker. Sold and installed by 16 partners in Poland.

sections.title: Grants and rules in Poland
paragraphs: Poland has no nationwide grant for chargers in apartment buildings at the moment. Regional programmes sometimes include charging, so ask your installer what applies locally.
points: Without a grant, the cost of the grid connection decides the project. Load management lets a housing community add chargers without paying for a larger connection.
Each resident pays for their own charging through VOOL, so the community does not issue invoices.

items.title: Apartment buildings
items.text: Many chargers on the existing main fuse, with each resident paying for their own charging.

items.title: Offices and fleets
items.text: Employees pay for private charging; company cars are reported separately.

items.title: Developers
items.text: Design charging into new buildings and size the connection smaller.

items.a: No. Local partners sell and install. VOOL makes the hardware and software and supports the partners.
From 1 January 2027 newly installed chargers in the EU must support ISO 15118-20. The new VOOL Charger does.

sections.title: Planning charging in Poland?
sections.lead: Send us the parking spaces and the main fuse size. We reply within one working day.
